alt.en: The worn tan paper cover of a songbook, printed in black: "Bright Melodies" in large ornamental letters on a stack of tilted sheets of paper tied with a ribbon, framed by flowers and scrolls, and below on a banner "Editors Jno. R. Sweney, J. H. Entwisle", "John J. Hood", "Chicago, 940 W Madison St" and "Price 30 cts, $3.00 per doz." A library label reading "F-46112 Sw42b" covers part of the lower left.
alt.es: La cubierta de papel color canela, gastada, de un cancionero, impresa en negro: "Bright Melodies" en grandes letras ornamentales sobre un montón de hojas de papel inclinadas y atadas con una cinta, rodeado de flores y volutas, y debajo, en una banda, "Editors Jno. R. Sweney, J. H. Entwisle", "John J. Hood", "Chicago, 940 W Madison St" y "Price 30 cts, $3.00 per doz." Una etiqueta de biblioteca con "F-46112 Sw42b" tapa parte de la esquina inferior izquierda.

caption.en: The cover of Bright Melodies (Philadelphia, 1899), the Sunday-school songbook edited by John R. Sweney and J. Howard Entwisle that holds the earliest known printing of Keep on the Sunny Side.
caption.es: La cubierta de Bright Melodies (Filadelfia, 1899), el cancionero para escuelas dominicales editado por John R. Sweney y J. Howard Entwisle que contiene la primera impresión conocida de Keep on the Sunny Side.

source: Bright melodies for the Sunday school and young people's societies, eds. Jno. R. Sweney and J. Howard Entwisle (Philadelphia: John J. Hood, 1899), front cover
library: Princeton Theological Seminary Library (digitized by the Internet Archive)
callNumber: SCC 5883 (cover label F-46112 Sw42b); OCLC 1041640804; Internet Archive brightmelodiesfo00swen, image n0
licenceEvidence: Published Philadelphia 1899 ("Copyright, 1899, by John J. Hood" on the title page); editors Sweney died 1899 and Entwisle died 1901; the cover's designer is unnamed. Public domain in the US (published before 1931) and past life plus 70 in the EU and Israel (see rights.md).
credit: Princeton Theological Seminary Library, via the Internet Archive

alt.en: A printed page numbered 128, titled "Keep On the Sunny Side of Life." in black-letter type, with "Ada Blenkhorn." on the left and "J. Howard Entwisle." on the right: four-part music on paired treble and bass staves in A-flat and 4/4, three verses printed between the staves, then a section marked "Chorus", and at the foot "Copyright, 1899, by J. Howard Entwisle."
alt.es: Una página impresa con el número 128, titulada "Keep On the Sunny Side of Life." en letra gótica, con "Ada Blenkhorn." a la izquierda y "J. Howard Entwisle." a la derecha: música a cuatro voces en pares de pentagramas de clave de sol y de fa, en La bemol y en 4/4, tres estrofas impresas entre los pentagramas, luego una sección marcada "Chorus", y al pie "Copyright, 1899, by J. Howard Entwisle."

caption.en: Page 128 of Bright Melodies (1899), the earliest known printing of the song: Ada Blenkhorn's words and J. Howard Entwisle's four-part setting, with his 1899 copyright at the foot.
caption.es: La página 128 de Bright Melodies (1899), la primera impresión conocida de la canción: la letra de Ada Blenkhorn y el arreglo a cuatro voces de J. Howard Entwisle, con su copyright de 1899 al pie.

source: Bright melodies for the Sunday school and young people's societies (Philadelphia: John J. Hood, 1899), p. 128, "Keep On the Sunny Side of Life"
library: Princeton Theological Seminary Library (digitized by the Internet Archive)
callNumber: SCC 5883; OCLC 1041640804; Internet Archive brightmelodiesfo00swen, image n131
